_comment: What a Dried Bouquet rehydrates into (#331, #335). One draw: the four vanilla tall flowers and
the large fern, which is the greenery every florist packs a bouquet with.
These five are exactly the two-block plants, and they were the whole gap, though not for one
reason. The wandering trader stocks every small flower and has never sold a tall one. The large
fern is different and its entry is worth reading twice: fern and large fern are both PLACED by
FertilizerScatter already, and the trader sells a fern - what does not exist is the large_fern
ITEM, because a placed large fern shears into minecraft:fern and never into itself.
So the four flowers are renewable once drawn (TallFlowerBlock is BonemealableBlock, and breaking
one returns the item) and the large fern is NOT: it is spent when placed, and no amount of bone
meal gives a second. Weights are flat anyway, because these are pre-beta placeholders like every
other weight here and the bouquet itself is renewable through household_pulls.
Rolled programmatically from RCCauldronInteractions (chest type gates the param set, as every
gameplay/ table here). Read by SortingData for the JEI hydrating row, so the odds shown are these.
